evidence.detail: The class owns Stack<Long> buffer addresses, a fixed long byte-capacity, an allocated flag and a renderer owner; its constructor takes (long, GpuRenderer).

It allocates reusable native blocks, frees all stored addresses, returns whether the pool is empty, converts returned IntBuffer/FloatBuffer objects back to addresses and recreates typed buffers from popped addresses.

A public 117 HD RSPS client preserves class BufferPool with the same Stack<Long>, byte-capacity/allocated state, native MemoryUtil allocation/freeing and put/take IntBuffer/FloatBuffer contract; the owner parameter is locally adapted from HdPlugin to the SpawnPK renderer.

candidates.note: BufferPool is corroborated by exact-v308 structure/consumers and matching public GPU-source identity. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.

evidence.detail: The class extends LinkedHashMap<Integer, FloatBuffer>, stores one BufferPool reference and constructs the map as an access-ordered cache.
Its room-making path evicts the eldest FloatBuffer back into BufferPool, while clear() returns every cached FloatBuffer to the same pool before removing it.

A public 117 HD RSPS client preserves FloatBufferCache with the same LinkedHashMap<Integer, FloatBuffer> inheritance, BufferPool constructor, eldest-entry makeRoom behavior and pooled clear implementation.

candidates.note: FloatBufferCache is corroborated by exact-v308 structure/consumers and matching public GPU-source identity. Exact v308 remains the semantic authority.

evidence.detail: The class is a static float[16] 4x4 matrix helper providing identity, scale, translation, axis rotations, projection and in-place matrix multiplication.
R87 GpuRenderer consumes these float[16] matrices as its OpenGL projection/model-view transforms before uploading them to shader uniforms.
RuneLite preserves net.runelite.client.plugins.gpu.Mat4 with the same private constructor and matching identity/scale/translate/rotate/projection/multiply float[16] API.
